researchCoverage.name: Devpost
researchCoverage.method: Official Devpost open-status JSON API, pages 1–7, traversed until the accumulated rows matched total_count; every retained official detail page was fetched during the refresh.
limitations: Scope follows Devpost open_state=open. Private/unlisted hackathons and items not exposed by the public API cannot be observed.

Devpost exposes exact deadline labels on detail pages, but full jurisdiction/age/team eligibility often resides in rules; records therefore do not generalize eligibility beyond the public invite-only flag.
AWS Trainium Frontier Competition was removed after the final live open-status API pass no longer returned it and its official detail page showed the event had ended on August 21, 2026.

researchCoverage.name: Kaggle Competitions
researchCoverage.method: Official Kaggle public internal CompetitionService ListCompetitions API queried with LIST_OPTION_ACTIVE and pageSize=100; totalResults=21 and no nextPageToken. Every returned record was then checked through the official GetCompetition endpoint and its public competition URL.
limitations: Completeness covers public competitions returned by Kaggle’s official LIST_OPTION_ACTIVE selector (date_enabled <= now < deadline); private, invitation-only, unlaunched, or unlisted competitions are not observable.
Kaggle’s legacy public REST competitions/list endpoint required authentication, so coverage used the same public proto3-JSON CompetitionService invoked by the logged-out competitions page.

The official HTML detail pages rendered an anti-forgery-token error through the text proxy; all structured fields were therefore verified against the official public GetCompetition endpoint, while public detail URLs were separately fetched.

The Pokémon simulation competition stopped accepting new entrants before the as-of date but remains submittable by existing eligible participants until 2026-08-31, so it is retained under the still-submittable criterion.
Eligibility summaries state only API-exposed restrictions; participants must review each official competition rules page for jurisdiction, age, data-use, and prize-specific conditions.

researchCoverage.name: DrivenData Competitions
researchCoverage.method: Official competitions listing traversed in full as one public page; 68 cards classified by section, then all 10 current prize/benchmark/practice detail pages fetched.
limitations: The public listing is a single page rather than a paginated API; completeness is claimed only for all 68 cards rendered on that official page.
Two current competitions are hosted on DrivenData-operated partner domains (K-12 AI Infrastructure and Mozilla Data Collective); their partner-domain official detail pages were verified.
Practice deadlines may be extended by DrivenData, as stated on the official pages.

researchCoverage.name: Zindi Competitions
researchCoverage.method: Official public Zindi API queried with status=open at per_page=100; meta total_count/open_count matched 5, then all five official public detail APIs and pages were fetched.
limitations: Completeness covers records returned by Zindi’s public API for status=open; private, invite-only, or unlisted challenges cannot be observed.
Four records have a null organization in the official API and are explicitly marked unknown instead of inferring a host.
Challenge rules can change; eligibility summaries preserve only directly verified headline restrictions and point to official detail pages.

researchCoverage.name: AIcrowd Challenges
researchCoverage.method: official listing page plus official challenge detail and rules pages
limitations: The listing card still labels Phase 1 as completed; the challenge detail's live round data was therefore checked and shows Phase 2 as UPCOMING from 2026-08-21T23:59:00Z through 2026-09-19T23:59:00Z.
All other 17 listing cards were marked completed. The listing container reported data-request-completed=true on page 1, so no further visible pages remained.

researchCoverage.name: DoraHacks Hackathons
researchCoverage.method: official listing with ongoing and upcoming filters plus every returned official hackathon detail page
limitations: Direct requests to dorahacks.io triggered an AWS WAF CAPTCHA. In accordance with the research boundary, no CAPTCHA was solved or bypassed; the public official URLs were read through a read-only rendering proxy.

The official ongoing filter returned 16 records and the upcoming filter returned 2 records, with no further pagination exposed for either filtered result. One ongoing-filter record was actually marked Winner Announced and was excluded as not actionable.

The three WEEX AI Wars II English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese listing records are localization variants of one event and are consolidated into one competition with all three official pages retained as sources.

Several organizers publish only a relative 'days left' label or explicitly say dates are TBA. Those deadline fields remain null instead of being inferred. Password-gated submission access on AlgoBharat and absent detail-page dates on BLI/MDBA are called out per record.

researchCoverage.name: lablab.ai Hackathons
researchCoverage.method: Fetched the complete official event listing rendered as a finite page, retained every card marked Register or TBA, excluded every card marked Finished, and opened the official detail page for all seven retained events.
limitations: Direct unauthenticated requests were challenged by Cloudflare, so the public official URLs were read through a read-only rendering proxy; no CAPTCHA was solved or bypassed.

The current official listing exposed 13 cards and no pagination or load-more control: five marked Register, two marked TBA, and six marked Finished. The sitemap was not accessible without the Cloudflare challenge.
AI GENESIS and The Rise of AI Agents are retained because the official listing offers signup while showing TBA. Their exact deadlines remain null rather than being inferred.

AI GENESIS contains an internal conflict: the listing and page header say all dates are TBA, while the body and schedule mention November 2. The more prominent TBA state controls the deadline field and the conflicting date is disclosed only as a provisional milestone.

researchCoverage.name: Hackster.io Contests
researchCoverage.method: official server-rendered listing payload, official active-contests RSS/Atom feeds, and official detail/rules pages
limitations: The listing's current competition payload contained three records: two IN_PROGRESS with registration open and one JUDGING with registration closed. The separate official active-contests RSS and Atom feeds contained exactly the same two open contests.

Some direct detail-page requests were later challenged by Cloudflare after the official listing succeeded, so the same public official detail and rules URLs were read through a read-only rendering proxy; no CAPTCHA was solved or bypassed.
The listing displays end dates as September 14 and December 21 in the viewer's timezone; binding rules specify September 13 and December 20 at 23:59 Pacific Time, which are used here.

researchCoverage.name: HackerEarth Challenges
researchCoverage.method: Fetched the finite official public compete API, then freshly fetched every previously known official detail URL because live HackerEarth detail pages exist outside that API feed.
limitations: The main /challenges catalogue returned HTTP 403 and the public API omitted several live official detail pages. The five retained known records were freshly checked, but a complete HackerEarth platform-universe claim is not defensible.
The public API mixes historical and current records; only API rows with a current/future end date were retained, then live known detail pages missing from the API were added after fresh date checks.
Some HackerEarth detail pages put prize information in images; those rewards were read from the official page image and are described without inferred cash values.

GitHub Repo Value Check is listed by HackerEarth as an active Hackathon, but its detail URL redirects to a repository-valuation tool with no public contest rules or prize terms; it is retained with partial verification rather than silently excluded.

HackerEarth's API gives Yuva Yodha a one-person team limit, while Schneider Electric's official detail page says individuals or teams of up to four; the detail-page rule is recorded and the conflict is disclosed.

researchCoverage.name: Devfolio Hackathons
researchCoverage.method: Official search API POST /api/search/hackathons queried separately for application_open and upcoming with size=100; returned hit totals were matched exactly, then all official Devfolio microsite URLs were checked
limitations: The Devfolio landing page shows only 20 open cards, but the official search API reported and returned 24 open records; the API total, not the homepage display limit, is used.
The official API returned 4 upcoming records, for a combined 28 actionable listings.
Many organizers leave hosted_by and prize descriptions empty; those fields are explicitly marked unknown instead of being inferred from sponsors or contact emails.
Devfolio uses the legacy Asia/Calcutta timezone label for most records; it is normalized to Asia/Kolkata without changing timestamps.
The Great Agent Hackathon is marked online in structured metadata while its public description says shortlisted teams attend an in-person Bangalore build; both stages are disclosed.

researchCoverage.name: Unstop Competitions
researchCoverage.method: Traversed the official public open-catalogue at per_page=100 until two consecutive full passes had stable totals and identical unique ID sets, then opened the official public detail API for every accepted ID and retained records with live registration or a current/future stage.
limitations: The completeListingClaim is limited to Unstop’s public open catalogue at the check time. The UI/API exposes open and closed lifecycle filters; an upcoming parameter was not recognized as a distinct public catalogue and returned the unfiltered 10,000-record cap.
The accepted 333-row snapshot contained one non-actionable row: Python with Real Life Quiz had no live registration or future stage in its final official detail response and was excluded.

The open catalogue changed during the August 21 refresh. Mixed-total passes were rejected; the result set was reconciled only after two consecutive full snapshots returned the same total and identical ID set.

For Codearambh 2.0, the event-specific Important Dates and prose both say registration closes October 10, while regnRequirements.end_regn_dt says September 30. The October 10 event-specific date controls and the conflict is disclosed in the record.

For EC-Council HackAI Challenge, the event prose says registration closes September 10 while regnRequirements.end_regn_dt says September 17. The more specific event prose controls the deadline shown to users and the conflict is disclosed.

Three records had registration_status=FINISHED; two were retained because their official details showed current or future stages for already-registered participants, while the stale record with no remaining stage was filtered out.

Two externally registered opportunities had regn_open=0 but an active structured registration window and public external registration URL; they remain actionable and are disclosed in their verification notes.
The catalogue intentionally includes records typed by Unstop as competitions, hackathons, and quizzes because all are returned by the official Competitions listing endpoint.
Some organizers omit structured prizes, concise eligibility, or venue details. Those fields are explicitly marked unknown rather than inferred from search snippets.

researchCoverage.name: Challenge.gov
researchCoverage.method: Checked the official Challenge.gov sunset notice, followed its official migration path to USA.gov, traversed the complete 10-item USA.gov page labelled active challenges, opened all 10 official USA.gov detail pages, and checked every linked hosting/action URL.
limitations: Challenge.gov was sunset on March 30, 2026 and no longer exposes a central live challenge catalogue.

The official successor page says it contains select active challenges, not every active federal prize competition. All 10 visible successor items were captured, but a complete U.S. federal-government universe claim is not defensible because agencies now publish additional challenges on their own sites.

Several USA.gov end dates describe the overall multi-phase challenge, not the next registration or submission cutoff; deadline labels preserve that distinction instead of treating every end date as a new-entry deadline.

The NIH NAMs challenge remains active only for Phase 1 winners; new public Phase 1 registration closed March 1, 2026. It is retained because the restricted Phase 2 cohort still has actionable milestones.

The CDC 1CDP hosting page returned HTTP 403 to the automated checker. The official USA.gov detail and HTTPS action URL were public, but the intake mechanism and full rules require manual confirmation.

researchCoverage.name: HeroX Challenges
researchCoverage.method: Official HeroX public challenge-search API queried with page_size=100 for stage=enter and stage=coming-soon; returned counts matched totals (44 and 17). All 61 official detail pages and timeline endpoints were fetched. Detail/timeline checks removed closed, non-actionable legacy records.
limitations: Completeness covers the two publicly actionable HeroX stage filters: enter (44) and coming-soon/pre-registration (17); private, invitation-only, or unlisted challenges cannot be observed.
13 records in the enter feed were excluded because their official detail page explicitly says closed to new competitors and their official timeline has no future milestone.

Three challenges closed to new competitors were retained because the official detail/listing shows an ongoing later phase or the official timeline has future actionable milestones; eligibility is limited to existing participants.
Eligibility summaries are conservative because the listing API does not expose structured rules; exact jurisdiction, age, team, and phase restrictions must be read on each official detail/rules page.

Independent audit removed 40 undated legacy enter/coming-soon records whose public detail pages did not provide a future actionable date; at least one (NIST Differential Privacy Synthetic Data Challenge) showed only a 2018–2019 competition window. They remain part of itemsSeen but are not treated as actionable on 2026-08-21.

researchCoverage.name: 阿里云天池大赛
researchCoverage.method: Official Tianchi competition list component API queried with isActive=1 across all four pages (pageSize=10; total=35). The 35 top-level records and 39 nested track records were normalized by raceId; non-actionable series containers and ended nested tracks were filtered, and all 25 unique actionable race detail URLs were fetched.
limitations: Completeness covers Tianchi’s public isActive=1 API. Private, invitation-only, or unlisted competitions cannot be observed.

The API returned 35 top-level records, including 10 series/container cards; their 39 nested track objects contained 14 currently active tracks already duplicated as top-level records and 25 ended tracks. Containers and ended tracks were excluded, leaving 25 unique actionable contests.

Six included contests have raceListStatus=2 (registration ended) but remain in the official active feed with a future raceEndTime; they are actionable only for already-registered eligible participants.
The official listing API supplies organizer logos but not organizer names, and does not label the timezone of its date-time strings; those fields are explicitly unknown rather than inferred.

Competition detail pages are client-rendered; their public URLs were fetched, while structured dates, status, prize, and tags come from the official active-list API. Eligibility must be checked on each official rules/detail page.

researchCoverage.name: DataFountain
researchCoverage.method: Traversed the official public /api/competitions catalog with all required query parameters at 30 items per page: pages 1–13 returned 370 unique records and every page reported total=370. Selected only records whose official listing and detail API both showed IN_SERVICE, isOpenSignup=1, and a future end/schedule, then fetched all 33 public detail pages and detail APIs.
limitations: The public status-filter endpoint (cmptStatus=2/3) returns a server error without login, matching the UI requirement to log in before using those filters. Completeness was instead established by traversing all 13 pages of the public unfiltered catalog and filtering its official state, signup, end-time, and detail schedule fields locally.

30 additional catalog records carried stale isOpenSignup=1 flags despite already-ended official end times; 39 separate records carried stale IN_SERVICE state with past end times and closed signup. They were excluded because the official dates made them non-actionable as of 2026-08-21.

29 included records are long-running training/entry competitions whose public data uses 2030 or 2099 horizon dates. Because their official descriptions or schedules describe ongoing training and isOpenSignup=1, they are actionable, but deadlineDate is null rather than treating a placeholder horizon as a real deadline.

Three active 2026 competitions (ids 1165, 1166, 1169) were already in a later stage at check time. The official API still reports signup open and the current phase remains submittable, but current action may be limited to teams that advanced from earlier phases.

Public structured fields do not provide a uniform location field, and some detailed eligibility conditions are embedded in long rules/documents; conservative summaries are provided and users must confirm the current phase rules before participating.
Private, invitation-only, unpublished, or login-only competitions cannot be observed from the public catalog.

researchCoverage.name: 讯飞开放平台 AI 开发者大赛
researchCoverage.method: official listing shell and its public contests-list API: all six type/status result sets (AI算法赛 and AI应用赛 × 未开始/进行中/已完赛) were requested with pageSize=1000 and each reported totalPages=1; every one of the 50 still-registerable track details was verified through its official page-data endpoint; the separately navigated official 星火杯 page was also reviewed
limitations: The six complete API result sets contained 629 unique contest_flag values: 334 ended algorithm tracks, 218 ended application tracks, 44 ongoing algorithm tracks, 33 ongoing application tracks, and no upcoming tracks. The separate 星火杯 navigation page brought the platform total seen to 630.

Of the 77 API records marked 进行中, 27 had both registration and preliminary/application submission deadlines before 2026-08-21 and no publicly verified next submission action for a new participant; they were excluded. The remaining 50 had registration/submission deadlines on or after the check date and were included.
The public listing API exposes most track deadlines only as dates, not times. Those deadline labels explicitly preserve the unknown time-of-day rather than assuming 23:59.

Track-specific eligibility prose varies and is not exposed in a consistent structured field. Where a precise restriction could not be reliably normalized, the record explicitly says it is unknown and directs the user to the verified official detail page.

The 2026 星火杯 initial registration/submission window closed August 13. It is included only because the official page announces an upcoming August 27–September 13 submission window for already-selected top-100 teams; it is not open to new registrations.

This coverage is limited to competitions surfaced by the current official AI算法赛、AI应用赛、星火杯 platform navigation/listing. Historical special-purpose routes that are not currently surfaced were counted only when present in the six listing result sets and were not treated as independently current.

researchCoverage.name: 华为云开发者大赛
researchCoverage.method: official platform landing page, all five pages of the public competition-list API (100/100/100/100/24 records), official public detail and tab APIs for every current record, and the official Huawei Developer competition component plus its current standalone competition page
limitations: The primary public competition API reported 424 records. All five pages were traversed with 424 unique competition_id values: four records had current_status=0 (进行中), none had current_status=1 (未开始), and 420 had current_status=2 (已结束).

One additional current developer competition, 2026 C4-AI, is promoted in Huawei Cloud's official developer-competition component but is not present in the 424-record competition API. It was added from that official component and its official standalone landing page, producing 425 unique seen items in scope.

The China-site API serializes times eight hours behind the dates/times rendered for the China audience (for example, 2026-09-04 15:59:59 in the API corresponds to September 4 at 23:59:59 China Standard Time). Human-readable dates on official detail tabs control where available; all timezone labels here are Asia/Shanghai.

The Challenge Cup/Huawei track is still accepting work from registered teams but registration closed June 30. C4-AI is in its semifinal phase and registration is closed; the public landing page does not expose the semifinal submission deadline or award amounts in text, so those fields remain explicitly unknown.

The Terminal BG Innovation Competition is restricted to finalists of the 2026 Huawei Terminal Hardware Elite Challenge; its official detail directs eligible entrants to contact track-specific Huawei email addresses rather than providing unrestricted public enrollment.

This coverage includes competitions published by the assigned Huawei Cloud developer competition platform and its official developer-competition component. General Huawei training camps, certification promotions, developer incentive programs, and contests listed only on other Huawei product ecosystems were outside this platform-specific scope.

researchCoverage.name: 腾讯云赛事平台
researchCoverage.method: Two official Tencent Cloud catalogues: the rendered Developer Community competition catalogue plus complete traversal of the live tch.cloud.tencent.com contest directory through its public POST listing API, native pagination, visible status/category filters, and official detail pages
limitations: The completion claim is scoped to the two named public official catalogues. It does not claim that every Tencent-affiliated event on partner sites or an unlinked microsite is indexed by either catalogue.

https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/competition exposed 20 unique official detail IDs in its public rendered catalogue and all 20 carried the label ‘已结束’. The two newest records were 2024 Energy Industry AI Application Competition tracks; official detail 10054 also states ‘赛事已结束’. Direct non-browser HTML is protected by a browser-verification response, so this catalogue was read through a public read-only renderer without attempting to bypass the check.

The live directory API /api/front/competition/online/page reported total=13 and pages=3 at the site's native pageSize=5. Pages 1, 2, and 3 returned 5, 5, and 3 records; page 4 returned zero. A separate pageSize=100 query returned the same 13 IDs. Visible filters were also checked: status 0 returned 0, statuses 1–5 returned 4, status 6 returned 9; category values 2, 3, and 4 returned 7, 2, and 0 respectively. Four legacy/new records use internal category values 0 or 1 and remain visible only through the unfiltered ‘全部’ view, which is why unfiltered pagination controls the completeness count.

The directory's ‘进行中’ family is not equivalent to actionable registration. Official detail nodes were checked for all four non-ended records: contest 44 registration ended 2026-08-20 and only has an offline event on August 22–23; contest 40 registration ended 2026-07-15 and its campus roadshow ended 2026-08-18; contest 41 registration ended 2026-05-31 and its roadshow ended 2026-07-31. None exposes a future public submission node. Only contest 43 has a future submission deadline and a current official partner registration call-to-action.

Tencent's contest 43 API supplies date-times but no timezone. The Indonesian partner page also publishes dates without a timezone, so timezone remains explicitly unknown rather than inferred. Registration can close earlier if the 300-participant completion quota is filled.

researchCoverage.name: ModelScope 魔搭赛事
researchCoverage.method: Traversed both pages of the official public GET /api/v1/competitions catalogue at PageSize=100 (100 + 27 = 127 records), filtered EventType=competition, reviewed all status=1 competition records against structured deadlines, and checked every retained public /events/<id>/summary route and official action URL.
limitations: The configured /competitions URL now redirects into /events, whose public API mixes competition and offline-event records; only EventType=competition was considered.

The catalogue status flag is stale for some historical records: 33 competition records had Status=1, but only 8 had a future structured registration cutoff or a specific upcoming narrative schedule; the other 25 lacked a future actionable deadline and were filtered out.

The per-event JSON detail endpoint requires login. Public catalogue records expose description/rules content, and all 8 public human detail routes returned HTTP 200, so no login or access-control bypass was attempted.
Some public records omit or image-encode eligibility, venue, or prize information; these fields are explicitly marked unknown rather than inferred.
For record 348, structured SignUpStart conflicts with the more specific narrative schedule (Sep 1–14); the narrative schedule is used and the conflict is disclosed.
The FlagOS action URL was explicitly published in the official ModelScope event content, but an automated TLS handshake to flagos.net failed during this check.

researchCoverage.name: 飞桨 AI Studio 赛事
researchCoverage.method: Queried the official GET /studio/match/search endpoint for Processing (matchStatus=1) and Not started (matchStatus=2) with pageSize=100; totals were 44 across one page and 0 across one page respectively. Fetched the official POST /studio/match/detail record for all 44 current listings, inspected every processList, and checked public human detail routes for all 41 retained records.
limitations: The public current listing contained 44 records and the public upcoming listing contained none; both reported totalPage=1, so no additional cursor existed.

Three current-list records were excluded because detail data said 报名截止 and every exposed stage had ended: IDs 800, 1461, and 1468. Their broader listing end dates were not treated as proof of actionability.

Thirty-two long-running 飞桨学习赛 records expose 立即报名 and 2030/2031 signup cutoffs, but their recurring processList currently materializes monthly scoring stages only through 2026-07. They are retained as registerable, while a current August submission window is explicitly unverified.

MICCAI2026 GAVE2 still exposes 立即报名 and a future platform cutoff, but its narrative preliminary stage is closed and Sep 5 submission is finalist-only; organizer confirmation is advised for new entrants.
Record 1415 is publicly listed and registerable but is explicitly titled 测试; award/production intent is unclear.
Registration/submission requires a user account, but listing data, rules, and detail pages were verified publicly without logging in; no access control was bypassed.
AI Studio timestamps are reported in local-looking strings without an explicit timezone label; Asia/Shanghai is used as platform context and disclosed on each record.

items.description:
科大讯飞作为国内领先的人工智能企业，在企业数字化转型领域积累了丰富的实践经验。随着大模型技术的快速发展，智能 Agent 正在成为企业提效的关键技术方向。

在企业日常运营中，员工每天需要处理大量重复性流程操作：预订会议室、提交请假申请、查询工位信息、申请报销等。这些任务往往需要在多个系统间切换，填写复杂表单，遵循严格的业务规则，耗费大量时间和精力。

本次大赛聚焦企业流程自动化执行场景，要求参赛者开发一个智能 Agent，能够理解员工的自然语言请求，自主规划并执行一系列工具调用，最终完成任务目标。这不仅是对大模型推理能力的考验，更是对工具调用、任务规划、约束满足等综合能力的全面检验。

items.description:
CODIA（Coder Diagnosis）是由中国科学技术大学认知智能全国重点实验室开发的智能编程平台，现有用户量 15500+、提交量 38w+。平台面向学生自学、教师授课、考研复试等场景，提供路径规划、自适应测评、用户认知诊断、智能习题推荐、代码修复等智能化服务，已应用于中科大认知智能全国重点实验室考研机试，以及程序设计、数据分析等课程上机实践中，服务广大教师与学生。

在编程学习、教学评测和科研探索中，测试样例是理解程序行为、验证代码正确性和发现潜在问题的重要工具。通常，一个测试样例只能覆盖代码的某一方面，若要全面考察边界情况、特殊输入、时间复杂度和空间复杂度等，需要设计大量高质量样例。然而，人工设计测试样例不仅耗时繁琐，还要求设计者充分理解题意、输入输出规范、数据范围、算法与数据结构等内容，并对样例逐一验证其正确性，工作量较大。因此，引入自动化方法辅助生成编程测试样例，对于提升评测效率、降低人工成本、增强代码质量分析能力具有重要意义。

items.description: 关于论文介绍：西孟加拉邦为实证研究提供了异常肥沃的土壤，正是这种品质，而不是任何情感依恋，推荐它作为学术研究的主题。这是一个内部差异明显的大州：沿河较古老的工业带、密集耕种的农业核心、北部的种植园经济、西部较干旱的地区、面临相当大气候风险的沿海三角洲，以及轮流利用这些因素的大都市劳动力市场。由于这些地区属于单一的国家政策体系，因此可以通过研究它们之间的差异来确定真正起作用的因素。此外，国家还通过长期的行政管理系列和每一次重大全国性调查的覆盖范围来服务，因此通常可以向多个……提出问题。

items.description: 关于辩论对一个国家经济轨迹的每一种解释都取决于之前做出的选择，即衡量什么、优先考虑什么以及接受什么作为可接受的进步成本。西孟加拉邦的经济经历了数十年的结构性变革，为这种审查提供了一个特别丰富的主题——不是因为它的记录已经尘埃落定，而是因为它的大部分内容仍然真正可以解释。当一个观察者看到适应时，另一个观察者可能会看到漂移；当一个人看到的是刻意构建的未来时，另一个人可能会看到一个默认到达的未来。正是这种对竞争性读物的开放性使得该主题适合辩论而不仅仅是描述。驾驭变革就是对什么应该保留、什么可以通过采取立场，即使这个立场从未被明确表达过。建设未来就是投入资源、关注……

items.description:
中文古诗词具有高度凝练性和语言的音乐美，讲究对仗、平仄和押韵。为了准确理解古诗的语义，不仅需要掌握古诗的语言特色，还需要调动对历史、文化背景的知识，结合对古诗中所描绘的自然景象和人物情感的认知，从而进行综合性的推理与理解。

为了进一步衡量模型在中文古诗词赏析场景中的语言理解深度与文化推理能力，我们推出第二届中文古诗词赏析评测。在第一届的基础上，本届评测进一步聚焦模型的深度理解与复杂推理能力，引入更具挑战性的高级任务，以全面考察模型对古诗词文化内涵与高层语义结构的掌握程度。

items.description: 近年来，研究者们发现现有的视觉问答模型倾向于依赖问题文本和答案之间的捷径(shortcut)，也称为语言偏见(language priors)，即仅根据文本和答案的共现关系就直接给出答案，而不是依赖于综合理解和推理能力。这样的模型在对应的分布外(Out of Distribution)数据集上将明显丧失能力。最近，我们发现视觉问答系统不仅仅依赖于语言偏见这一种捷径，还有很多其他捷径存在，同时，我们还发现当前的OOD评测流程中存在一些不规范的设定，如直接用测试集做模型选择。因此，为了更好地评测视觉问答的泛化能力，我们给出了包含针对多种捷径(varying shortcuts)的OOD测试集的新评测基准VQA VS，同时进一步规范了OOD评测流程，以提供更可靠、可依赖的模型鲁棒性评估能力。…

items.description: 煤炭的发热量（热值）是评估煤炭质量、定价以及指导优化燃烧的核心指标。传统的发热量测定通常采用弹筒发热量计（Bomb Calorimeter）在实验室内进行，该过程步骤繁琐、存在滞后性，难以满足煤场现场实时调控的需求。激光诱导击穿光谱（LIBS，即 Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy）技术能够直接在煤场现场皮带上对煤流进行在线光谱快速采集。本赛题旨在利用先进的算法模型，建立现场皮带 LIBS 光谱数据与实验室标准弹筒发热量之间的精准映射关系，推动煤炭质量的在线感知与智能化检测。

items.description:
随着大语言模型在教育问答、智能助手和跨语言应用中的使用越来越广，模型面对的任务已经不再局限于单一语言。一个真正可用的模型，不仅要能读懂中文或英文题目，还要能在不同语言表达下保持稳定的理解和推理能力。

items.description:
水资源是国家生态安全与经济社会发展的基础性资源。水体信息的精准提取，在防汛减灾、水资源管理、生态环境监测、农业灌溉以及国土调查等领域具有重要应用价值。传统水体提取主要依赖人工解译或基于光谱特征的中低分辨率遥感影像，存在效率低、边界粗糙、难以识别细小水体等问题。随着高分辨率遥感卫星数据应用的发展，亚米级影像为精细尺度上的水体分割提供了可能，但也带来了新的技术挑战：水体形态复杂多样、影像中的阴影、建筑物、道路等地物与水体特征相近，易产生混淆，增加了分割的难度。
在此背景下，我们发起本次挑战赛，旨在汇聚产学研力量，探索适用于复杂场景下的水体智能分割算法，提升水体边界提取的精细度与鲁棒性，为水资源管理等领域提供有力技术支撑。

items.description:
国土空间规划、耕地保护、生态红线监管以及城市精细化治理，均高度依赖准确、现势的土地利用信息。传统人工调查等方式难以满足当前的业务需求。高分辨率遥感卫星数据应用的发展，为区分复杂土地利用类型提供了数据基础，但也带来新的挑战。如何利用人工智能算法实现高精度、大范围、多类别的自动化土地利用分类，已成为自然资源监测与国土空间治理的关键技术方向。

为此，我们发起本次挑战赛，旨在汇聚产学研力量，突破高分辨率遥感影像在复杂场景下的精细分类难题，推动遥感智能解译技术向业务化、标准化方向演进，为国土调查、生态评估与城市管理等应用提供可靠技术支撑。

items.description:
随着5G/6G、卫星通信、深空探测、数据存储等领域的飞速发展，信息的可靠传输已成为数字社会的基石。在信号传输过程中，噪声、干扰和衰减不可避免，纠错码作为保障通信可靠性的核心技术，被广泛应用于从移动通信到闪存控制的各种场景。

传统的纠错码解码算法经过数十年发展已相当成熟，但往往面临性能与复杂度的根本性权衡：高性能解码通常伴随高计算开销，难以满足低延迟、低功耗的现代通信需求。近年来，深度学习技术，在解码任务中展现出突破传统算法的潜力，有望能够以神经网络逼近最优解码边界。

items.description:
野生动物个体识别是智慧生态保护、种群监测、行为分析和栖息地评估中的关键基础任务。随着红外相机、巡护设备和野外监测网络的持续建设，保护人员能够长期采集到大量野生动物图像资料，但如何从海量图像中快速、准确地确认个体身份，仍然是生态保护与智能分析中的重要难题。

对于部分具有稳定外观差异的野生动物，例如头部纹理、体侧条纹、斑点分布、毛色块状特征或局部轮廓结构等，图像中往往包含可用于区分个体身份的视觉信息。这为基于计算机视觉的个体识别研究提供了可行基础。为了降低任务门槛并聚焦于身份识别能力，本赛题不设置整图目标检测任务，而是统一围绕动物局部部位图像开展识别评测。

本赛题聚焦东北虎个体识别场景，面向裁剪后的部位图像开展个体身份识别评测。

items.description:
随着科技的不断进步以及教育信息化、智能化需求的持续增长，智慧课堂逐渐成为教育领域的重要发展方向。以人工智能、大数据和计算机视觉为代表的新一代信息技术，正在深刻改变传统教学模式。课堂场景中的行为识别与状态分析，已成为实现教学质量评估与个性化教学的重要技术支撑。

在智慧课堂环境中，基于视觉感知的图像处理与目标检测技术，能够对学生的课堂行为进行自动识别与分析。例如，通过对课堂视频数据的处理，可以识别学生上课时的行为状态，从而为教师提供更加直观、实时的课堂反馈信息。图像识别技术通过分析课堂图像内容，提取关键特征，实现对学生个体及群体状态的感知；而目标检测技术则在此基础上，对学生行为类别及变化趋势进行精确定位与分类，从而提升课堂行为分析的准确性与实时性。

近年来，脑机接口技术发展迅速，基于脑电（EEG）信号的环境感知与场景分类逐渐成为研究热点。通过对脑电信号中听觉相关信息的建模与解码，实现对个体所处环境场景的识别，有助于推动辅助听觉设备、智能家居控制、医疗监测等领域的发展。

相较于传统仅基于外部音频信号的场景分类任务，类脑听觉场景分类更加关注听觉刺激与脑电响应之间的内在关联，具有更强的交叉学科研究意义与应用价值。然而，目前基于脑电的场景分类任务仍面临样本量有限、信号信噪比较低、个体差异显著、模型泛化能力不足等挑战。

为进一步推动类脑听觉语义解码与脑机接口技术的发展，本次挑战赛在基础版赛题基础上推出进阶版任务。进阶版将同时提供受试者在听取场景音频刺激时记录的脑电数据以及对应音频数据，鼓励参赛者探索更加有效的脑电建模方法、跨模态融合策略与鲁棒分类模型，提升场景分类性能与泛化能力。

items.description:
随着全球航运业的数字化转型以及对智能水面辅助导航系统需求的日益增长，水上视觉感知技术已成为智慧海洋与智能交通领域的新焦点。图像语义分割（Image Segmentation）是实现船舶自动靠泊、航道障碍物预警及港口自动化管理的核心技术之一。

通过对水面图像进行像素级的分析，船体分割技术能够将图像中的“船舶”与“水面”、“岸景”及“背景”精确分离。相比于传统的目标检测，船体分割能够提取目标的精确轮廓、面积和形状特征，为无人艇或大型货轮提供更细腻的环境感知能力。

因此，本赛题以船体图像的语义分割挑战为例，旨在通过算法提升在复杂水面环境，如波浪干扰、光影变化、雨雾天气下，对船舶边缘提取的准确性和鲁棒性，从而保障航行安全并提升自动化作业效率。

items.description:
妮娜皇后葡萄是我国近年引进推广的高端红色鲜食葡萄品种，单串市场售价高，商品性对果穗外观与果粒品质要求极高。在葡萄的全生命周期管理中，果粒级的精准识别是产量估计、精细化疏果决策与采收辅助的数据基础。为辅助穿戴式视觉设备、农业机器人或果园管理系统开展果穗质量评估与精细化管理，首先需要实现对密集果粒的像素级实例分割。

真实田间环境下妮娜皇后果穗果粒高度密集、相互堆叠遮挡，叠加棚架农膜与枝叶遮挡、光照剧变（顺光、逆光、树冠阴影）与复杂背景，导致果粒边缘粘连严重、特征丢失，精准分割难度大。

本赛题以农业果粒实例分割为研究方向，推动计算机视觉技术在复杂田间场景的优化，遴选可适配密集目标、重度遮挡、光照剧烈变化工况的高精度算法。

AFAC大赛设立算法赛、应用赛的综合赛制结构，旨在以真题促真力，以金融行业内真实案例及海量真实数据为牵引，设立百万奖金池，鼓励业内外具有潜力的创新者积极参与，将赛事成果应用到实际产业中。同时，AFAC大赛也是“创·在上海”国际创新创业大赛的专题赛之一。
items.audience: 官方列表状态：报名已结束，但比赛仍保留在天池的活跃源中，直到未来的raceEndTime；仅适用于已经注册的合格参与者。查看官方规则。
